frequency_question: How often does a central bank implement a tightening hike within any randomly selected 3-month window during a non-easing monetary stance?
membership_rule: Includes any tightening decisions by the Reserve Bank of India, Bank Indonesia, or Banco Central do Brasil during active rate-hiking cycles since 2016. Excludes emergency pandemic rate cuts and long extended plateau periods where zero changes occurred.
provenance_note: claims 24 cases from only 7 named (3.4x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 7 named active instances within targeted windows; total population estimated at roughly 10 similar structural instances.
known_gaps: Excludes minor inter-meeting liquidity adjustments that did not alter the formal repo rate.
skeleton: RBI tightening cycles mapped to quarterly policy meeting schedules
multiplier: 7 active hiking meetings out of 24 total meetings evaluated across recent tightening windows
validity_reason: Central bank reaction functions and inflation-targeting frameworks evolve slowly over multi-year horizons.
